name: Modern Product Search for WooCommerce
author: TeamMWS

sections.description:
Finding the right product quickly is critical for customer satisfaction and conversions. The default WooCommerce search is often slow and inaccurate — frustrating customers and costing you sales.

Modern Product Search for WooCommerce replaces the default search with a lightning-fast AJAX-powered search engine that delivers relevance-based results in real time. It creates a dedicated search index for your products, ensuring high performance even on large stores with thousands of items.

With features like smart relevance scoring, product images in results, SKU search, and customizable design, Modern Product Search transforms the shopping experience for your customers.

✨ Features

  • ⚡ Real-Time AJAX Search – Instant product results while typing.
  • 🎯 Relevance-Based Algorithm – Prioritizes title, SKU, description, categories, tags, and attributes.
  • 🛍️ Seamless WooCommerce Integration – Works with simple, variable, grouped, and external products.
  • 📊 Optimized Indexing – High-performance search engine for large catalogs (10k+ products).
  • 🔍 Flexible Search Sources – Choose from title, SKU, description, categories, tags, and attributes.
  • 🎨 Customizable Frontend – Shortcode [mpsfw_search_form] and widget support.
  • 🖥️ Enhanced UX – Show product image, price, rating, and add-to-cart button directly in results.
  • 📱 Responsive – Fully mobile and tablet friendly.

🚀 Benefits

  • Boost conversions with faster product discovery.
  • Enhance user experience with live, relevant results.
  • Scale easily, even for large WooCommerce stores.
  • Developer friendly with hooks and filters.
  • Secure, optimized, and lightweight.

💡 Use Cases

  • Fashion stores: Search by size, color, or category.
  • Electronics shops: Search by specs, attributes, or SKU.
  • Wholesale stores: Quick lookup by SKU or product code.
  • Large catalogs: Handle 50,000+ products without lag.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/modern-product-search-for-woocommerce/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress Plugins page.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Modern Search to configure settings.
  4. Add the search form using the shortcode [mpsfw_search_form] or via the widget.
  5. Enjoy a modern, lightning-fast WooCommerce search experience!
sections.faq:
Does it replace the default WooCommerce search?

Yes. Modern Product Search overrides the default WooCommerce search for faster, more accurate results.

Can it handle large stores with 10k+ products?

Absolutely. It uses a dedicated index table optimized for performance, suitable for very large catalogs.

Does it support SKU search?

Yes. Customers can search by product name, SKU, categories, tags, and attributes.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes. The plugin is fully responsive and optimized for all devices.

Can I customize the search form design?

Yes. You can modify the placeholder text, add a search button, or place it anywhere using the shortcode or widget.
